feature: CN receiving upload — truck-manifest Excel format (車單, e.g. CSZ00 per-truck lists): auto-detected on upload and split client-side into one draft (one pending order) per INVOICE NO, multi-brand; carries blank C/No. continuation rows down to their carton, counts cartons once per invoice, maps PO NO/Our P/No./Quantity/G.W/OFFICE NAME/trailing remark onto the existing decode→verify→create flow
reason: Customers ship per-truck manifests with many supplier invoices per file (34 invoices / 257 rows / 181 cartons in the reference file) next to the single-invoice 收貨確認書; the existing decoder found no 訂單號 header and rejected the file
remarks: Implemented 2026-11-10 — spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-receiving-cn-truck-manifest-upload-design.md`; backend contract unchanged (N payload entries = N orders already supported). `parseCnManifestAoa` in `apps/admin/utils/cnReceivingExcel.ts`, detection order in `apps/admin/pages/receiving-cn/new.vue`; fixture + tests in `apps/admin/tests/cnReceivingExcel.test.ts` (`supporting_doc/cn_receiving/CSZ00-manifest-20261102.xls`).
